cases.sentence: За то, что вы клещами хлопали против ___.
cases.translation: Because you clapped your hands against the land.
cases.explain: The preposition против (against) governs the genitive case.

cases.translation: I will give you to plunder by nations.
cases.explain: Народы is the direct object of отдам, taking the accusative case.
Крепости is a direct object of разрушу, taking the accusative case.

cases.translation: And I will destroy your walls.
cases.explain: Стены is the direct object of разрушу.

cases.translation: For thus says the Lord God.
cases.explain: Бог is in apposition with the verb and takes the nominative case.

cases.translation: From all the malice of your heart.
cases.explain: The preposition от (from) governs the genitive case.

cases.translation: I stretch out my hand against you.
cases.explain: Руку is the direct object of the verb протягиваю.

cases.translation: And I hear the word of the Lord.
cases.explain: Слово is the direct object of the verb слышу.

reading.ru: За то, что клещами вы хлопали от всей злости сердца против земли израильской.
reading.question: Why does God express anger toward Tyre?
options: Because the city clapped hands in malice against Israel
Because the city refused to worship God
Because the city failed to pay tribute
reading.correct: Because the city clapped hands in malice against Israel
reading.explain: The text states that God is angry 'because you clapped your hands in all your malice against the land of Israel.'

reading.ru: Я протягиваю руку мою на тебя и отдам грабежам народы.
reading.question: What does God promise to do in response to Tyre's actions?
options: Stretch out his hand and make the city a plunder to nations
Send rain to destroy the city
reading.correct: Stretch out his hand and make the city a plunder to nations
reading.explain: God declares He will stretch out His hand and make Tyre a plunder to the nations.

reading.ru: И разрушу твои крепости и стены твои разрушу.
reading.question: What structures will God destroy?
options: The strongholds and walls of Tyre
reading.correct: The strongholds and walls of Tyre
reading.explain: God explicitly states He will destroy the city's strongholds and walls.

reading.ru: За то, что клещами вы хлопали от всей злости сердца против земли израильской, я протягиваю руку мою на тебя.
reading.question: To whom is God speaking in this verse?
reading.explain: God addresses Tyre directly, using 'you' in singular form, and references Tyre's malice against Israel.

reading.ru: Я отдам грабежам народы и разрушу твои крепости.
reading.question: How will Tyre's fate be executed?
options: Through plunder by nations and destruction of strongholds
reading.correct: Through plunder by nations and destruction of strongholds
reading.explain: The text indicates the city will become plunder for nations and its strongholds will be destroyed.

reading.ru: Клещами вы хлопали от всей злости сердца против земли израильской.
reading.question: What does 'clapping hands' symbolize in this context?
options: Malicious joy and contempt at Israel's misfortune
reading.correct: Malicious joy and contempt at Israel's misfortune
reading.explain: The clapping of hands with 'all the malice of your heart' indicates scorn and hostile glee at Israel's suffering.
